dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shape with a relatively flat and even posterior margin across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick band, occupying approximately 35% of the visible dorsal-to-ventral torso height at the lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish-yellow discoloration present on the normally white dorsal and posterior fur regions.
